verdict.rationale: Open WebUI supports building distinct custom models/agents via Functions/Pipes (each with own prompt, model, and appearing as a selectable model), workspaces per agent (one worktree/workspace/agent pattern), and Channels as shared spaces for routing conversations, plus sub-agent delegation via delegate_task. This covers most of the story's orchestration needs but lacks a single unified first-party 'multi-agent routing' feature that explicitly routes channels to specific agents by rule, and no independent/hands-on evidence confirms this works smoothly at scale. Missing for 10: explicit channel-to-agent routing rules/documentation, independent corroboration of multi-agent workflows in practice, and clearer distinction between 'agents' vs 'models' as first-class routable entities.
